experiment: P5 logistic ranker rolling-year replication and label-permutation controls
method: Same pooled binary LogisticRegression C=0.05 with StandardScaler; for each yearly test period fit only on all preceding target dates; labels are actual draw maximum among numbers 1..40.

permutation_control.method: In training set only, independently permute candidate-number labels within each draw, preserve one-positive-per-draw, fit identical model; evaluate ranks against true P5 on 2025-01-01 through 2026-11-04.
permutation_control.interpretation: Permutation outcomes cluster near 12.5% chance baseline (range 11.89%-18.28%), substantially below original 42.79%. Supports association between feature-number rows and P5 label; does not yet exclude all leakage or dataset-specific artifacts.

caveats: Rolling-year replications support temporal persistence in this dataset, not a lottery guarantee or 80% reliability.
Permutation control is limited to five seeds; expand controls and audit feature lineage/target alignment before model promotion.
P5 label distribution and feature rank semantics need further diagnosis.
next_steps: Audit feature generation chronology and each feature definition, particularly rank_consensus_27 and novelty residual features
Expand permutation and temporal-label shift controls
Run subperiod and number-band calibration; compare a simpler pre-registered baseline
